notes.title: [Update 1] Terrain changes and new stories
notes.notes:
Hello. Everyone who has enjoyed healing. 

This update is the first update of Healing Animal.
Terrain and stories related to elephants have been added.
In addition, the shape of the map that was divided into multiple terrains in one street was changed to a central dense type.
Need's growth system added and additional bug fixes.

 Elephant Update 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39258448/439bbae65e9a595568c1cde6e2e11b65314f553b.png

 Terrain change 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39258448/248a003721c02965ac1b4b443db19cccee474e9b.png

 Nid growth system 

 Nid's growth scene and system added


 Additional stories 

 A device that allows a glimpse of the girl's past and inner world is updated in the terrain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39258448/f08f386ec3eda005edfaf10b87da35332740bc3d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39258448/c0eac8943d709915279a8e481f4c05f7424e8b60.png

 Other changes 

 Adjustment of the movement balance of transformable animals
- Change movement speed, jumping power, and viewing angle
 Fixed an issue where items were stuck in the ground
 Fixed the problem that the sound was temporarily louder
 Fixed the problem that it became too dark when using the skill (Some animals are kept.)
 Fixed an issue where the correct bear puzzle piece was not saved.
 Fixed the problem that the game was stopped while the bear story was in progress
 Fixed some problems that made progress impossible
